description: Connect Excalidraw to automate images and design workflows.

excalidraw_new_collection_trigger.description: Runs when new collection appears after the initial complete scan. Polls at your plan interval; updates between polls may be combined. Watches at most 4,000 records.

excalidraw_new_scene_trigger.description: Runs when new scene appears after the initial complete scan. Polls at your plan interval; updates between polls may be combined. Watches at most 4,000 records.

excalidraw_updated_scene_trigger.description: Runs when scene updated appears after the initial complete scan. Polls at your plan interval; updates between polls may be combined. Watches at most 4,000 records.
